mainEntity.name: How does Shopify development work with MMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: We plan the structure, design for a phone first, build a lean fast theme, tune checkout and payments, connect analytics, Meta and your CRM, and test before launch.
We quote per project, after a call, once the scope is clear: what you need, how much of it, and what it has to connect to. The scope and the fee are agreed in writing before work starts.
No. We cannot guarantee sales from a store, because traffic, price and product matter too. We commit to a fast, measurable build, tested before launch, and honest reporting afterwards.

leaks.note: Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.
leaks.lede: A store is hard to fix once it is live. Each stage below is where stores go wrong, and how we build it right.

stages.breaks: Starting with a template and a logo.
stages.why: Navigation, collections and page types decide how easily shoppers find things. Fixing them after launch is slow and costly.
stages.does: We plan the catalogue, navigation and page types first, from how your customers search and shop, before any design.

stages.breaks: A beautiful home page and weak product pages.
stages.why: Most buying decisions are made on product pages, where shoppers look for proof, clarity and reassurance.
stages.does: We design the home page, collections and product pages so the brand feels credible and the product is easy to understand.

stages.breaks: Loading heavy images and unnecessary apps.
stages.why: Slow pages lose shoppers before they see a product, especially on mobile networks.
stages.does: We build lean themes, optimise images and limit apps, so the store loads fast on a phone.

stages.breaks: A checkout that surprises shoppers at the end.
stages.why: Extra steps, forced accounts and missing payment options end sales that were already decided.
stages.does: We set up checkout with the payment methods Indian shoppers expect, including UPI, cards and cash on delivery, and keep it short.

stages.why: Without correct analytics and event tracking, ad platforms and your team cannot see what works.
stages.does: We connect analytics, Meta, your CRM and email or WhatsApp tools, and check that events fire correctly before launch.
